connection_closure_reproduction.root_cause: All 12 failures are the first request after a suite's 65- or 90-second delay. The server default idle request deadline is 10000 ms (src/server_config.c); the JSON runner retained cached admin and player sockets across delay commands. The server closes idle sockets after the deadline; the next send then observes EOF. Subsequent operations reconnect and pass. No server process crash was observed.

stale_socket_fix_verification.note: The suite includes a 65-second idle delay; formerly failing admin SQL query and player hardware purchase both passed after reconnecting cached clients before the server's idle deadline.

targeted_protocol_and_scheduler_verifica.disposition: Targeted repairs are not fully green. Do not start canonical full regression until the three cluster-pressure failures and MSL beacon case are investigated. No skipped case is counted as passed.

defects.root_cause: Fixtures move active ports into sectors already occupied by another active port, contradicting the V3 one-active-StarPort-per-sector invariant.
defects.evidence: Preserved run returned PostgreSQL unique-index idx_ports_loc violations for sectors 1 and 2. Canonical migration: sql/pg/181_active_starport_sector_uniqueness.sql. Fixture definitions: tests.v2/suite_information_fog.json and suite_port_fixed_modes.json.

defects.root_cause: A single prepared sys.raw_sql_exec request contains an INSERT followed by SELECT pg_sleep, which PostgreSQL rejects as multiple commands in one prepared statement.
defects.evidence: The preserved response reports 'cannot insert multiple commands into a prepared statement'; the delay has no gameplay purpose and was removed while preserving the INSERT.

defects.root_cause: The suite invokes repo_clusters_record_crime, a C repository function, as though it were a PostgreSQL SQL function. No SQL function with that name exists.
defects.evidence: Five preserved PostgreSQL errors report no matching repo_clusters_record_crime(integer, integer, integer, integer). The fixture now seeds/query-checks incident state directly; real crime-event behavior remains covered through player commands in the Phase B suite and requires focused confirmation.

defects.root_cause: The fixture moves the active ship to sector 679 without moving its owning player's sector, violating the database active-ship-sector invariant.
defects.evidence: Preserved PostgreSQL error is SHIP_ACTIVE_SECTOR_MISMATCH. The setup now updates ship and player together and checks respawn at the actual origin sector 679.

defects.root_cause: Legacy tests assume arbitrary commodity codes can be attached to port_trade, while the V3 port protocol and canonical PostgreSQL schema constrain StarPort commodities to ORE, ORG, EQU, SLV, WPN and DRG.
defects.evidence: Preserved SQL errors name port_trade_commodity_check and reject ALT. The allowlist is sql/pg/000_tables.sql and the V3 commodity list is docs/PROTOCOL.v3/19_Ship_Commands.md; no production schema or gameplay change is authorized by this repair task.
defects.disposition: Archive the V2 arbitrary-commodity assertions; do not insert ALT into canonical commodities, port_trade, or entity_stock.

defects.root_cause: The fixture independently chooses a RANDOM-cluster sector and then looks for a port in that sector, so the selected sector can have no port and the saved port ID is null.
defects.evidence: Preserved SQL result for the selected sector was 172; the subsequent port query returned no rows. The selection query now joins ports before choosing the sector.

defects.root_cause: The newly created test player may start in a sector with no outgoing warp, leaving route_from and route_to unset before the request.
defects.evidence: Preserved SQL response returned an empty row set and the request then failed schema validation because from_sector_id was not an integer. The fixture now selects an existing warp and moves the player and active ship to its origin.

defects.root_cause: json_runner.py treats db_setup as a complete test and returns before executing the same test's command and save operations, leaving the planet ID variable unset.
defects.evidence: In tests.v2/json_runner.py::_run_test_impl, successful db_setup returns True before command execution and save handling. The planet.deposit requests consequently contain an unresolved planet_id.

defects.root_cause: The suite requires TLS while the ordinary regression listener is plaintext and its cases use legacy request/requests DSL. The runner now reports a skip instead of a false pass or unhandled exception.
defects.evidence: TLS run /tmp/twclone-tls-smoke-20261113-report.json executed 4, passed 4, failed 0, skipped 0 on the disposable PostgreSQL and real TLS-enabled V3 server.
defects.disposition: Converted to current V3 JSON-RPC cases; temporary self-signed TLS is enabled only in the disposable QA database for this dedicated suite.

defects.root_cause: The runner had no executable JSON-RPC representation for the legacy Phase 10 step-DSL test. Two other reported entries are generated inventory artifacts, not test suites.
defects.evidence: The prior full report listed REGRESSION_FAILURE_CLASSIFICATION.json and protocol_coverage_report.json with zero declared cases, plus suite_phase10_market_decay.json with six nested cases. Phase 10 is now converted to 15 direct JSON-RPC cases and ran against the real server; see targeted_protocol_and_scheduler_verification. The two report artifacts remain non-executable, zero-case entries and are never counted as passes.
defects.disposition: Do not count generated reports as tests. Execute Phase 10 through supported direct JSON-RPC cases; no skipped or unsupported case counts as passed.

defects.root_cause: The runner retained admin and player sockets past the server's 10000 ms idle request deadline. All historical failures followed 65- or 90-second suite delays; next operation used a stale socket. Runner now reconnects cached clients proactively at 75% of the configured server idle deadline and reauthenticates them.
defects.evidence: All 12 reproduced in the six-suite run: /tmp/twclone-v3-closures-ht2cT1/report.json. Server default: src/server_config.c:71. Post-fix runtime: /tmp/twclone-v3-stale-socket-fixed-umPdHy/report.json (29/29) plus /tmp/twclone-focused-closures-20261113-report.json (119/119). All 12 affected closure cases now pass. A unit test also verifies a non-idempotent bank.transfer is sent once and not replayed after an ambiguous disconnect.

defects.root_cause: Tests use port.get_trade_info, port.trade.buy and port.trade.sell. V3 registry names are port.info/trade.port_info and trade.buy/trade.sell. Some Phase 3 ALT cases also have a separate V3 commodity-schema conflict recorded above.
defects.evidence: Preserved responses contain 11 UNKNOWN_COMMAND errors. src/server_loop.c registers port.info, trade.port_info, trade.buy and trade.sell, not these aliases. The archived suites also contain invalid ALT assumptions, undefined port fixture variables and pre-V3 request fields. Replacement coverage is exercised by current port/cargo/trade suites.
defects.disposition: Archive the two obsolete V2 suites. V3 trade coverage remains in suite_port_fixed_modes.json, suite_ship_cargo_dynamic.json and suite_trade_illegal.json; do not add server aliases.

defects.root_cause: Tests request auth.mfa_verify; current registered TOTP API is auth.mfa.totp.verify.
defects.evidence: src/server_loop.c registers auth.mfa.totp.verify with required code field; the handler returns REFUSED because MFA is disabled. Corrected suite /tmp/twclone-mfa-alias-20261113-report.json passed 7/7, including both refusal checks.
defects.disposition: RENAME_TO_AUTH_MFA_TOTP_VERIFY_AND_CHANGE_TOKEN_TO_CODE; existing handler deliberately returns REFUSED because MFA is disabled. Preserve the refusal assertion; do not implement an MFA alias.

defects.root_cause: Tests call the generic sys.run_cron_handler hook through player JSON. It is neither registered nor part of the V3 client contract; specific cron commands are exposed instead.
defects.evidence: src/server_loop.c has no sys.run_cron_handler. Tests set cron_tasks.next_due_at in the disposable DB and await the real engine. /tmp/twclone-cron-hooks-20261113-report.json: NPC 12/12 passed; MSL 42/43, with case-0034 showing that sectors.beacon survives the sweep while sector_assets are the only table removed.
defects.disposition: REPLACE_WITH_EXISTING_ENGINE_SCHEDULER_SETUP: set the relevant cron_tasks.next_due_at in the disposable DB, allow the real engine tick to run, and assert persisted effects. For NPC tests use the registered sys.npc.ferengi_tick_once only where its semantics match; never add a generic player-facing cron hook.

defects.root_cause: The test calls sysop.motd.set, sysop.port.restock and sysop.audit.tail; none is registered or documented as a V3 client command.
defects.evidence: No matching entries in src/server_loop.c or docs/PROTOCOL.v3. The commands were in legacy_v2_sysop_world.json and are excluded from executable V3 suite discovery.
defects.disposition: REMOVE_AS_OBSOLETE_V2_TEST_COMMANDS; no approved V3 command contract exists for MOTD mutation, port restock queueing, or global audit-tail retrieval. Keep documented sysop.config.*, sysop.jobs.*, and relevant SQL fixture checks; do not add undocumented commands.
